description: The Esri release provides the 2020 District Heating and Cooling asset data model. It identifies an asset package and data dictionary for district heating, steam and district cooling information management. The provider is Esri. Coverage: The schema is generic, not an observed network. It is explicitly the 2020 edition; individual asset coverage and geometry precision depend on populated data. Access: The public official release page describes the package and dictionary. Neither was downloaded; ArcGIS and downstream access conditions were not tested. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: A data model provides definitions, not populated infrastructure data or a physical solver. Its suitability for current software versions was not checked. For simulation it can guide asset attributes and data exchange before model construction. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this named district-energy schema edition.
